subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Pegasus Spyware
description: A micro-lesson that makes Pegasus Spyware usable.

hook.text: A text message you never opened could turn your phone into a spy device. That's Pegasus.

buildup.text: Built by Israel's NSO Group, Pegasus infects phones silently — accessing cameras, mics, and messages.

discovery.text: Governments bought Pegasus to spy on journalists, activists, and political opponents worldwide.

twist.text: NSO claimed it only sold to governments fighting terrorism. Leaked data showed otherwise.

climax.text: Pegasus proved that surveillance technology sold to governments will be abused by governments.

punchline.text: Built for terrorists. Used on journalists.

quiz.question: What makes Pegasus spyware particularly dangerous?
options: It can infect phones silently without user interaction
It only works on old phone models
It requires physical access to the phone
